items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Him and Hal Smith, they got together and that’s as good as any jazz I’ve ever heard on a record.

ctx.x: Those arrangements. The last song they played, I was watching Bob Haggart. And I want to go right out and learn the bass now. I really do. Him and Hal Smith, they got together and that’s as good as any jazz I’ve ever heard on a record.
It has a pulse to it when it get going—
